## Checklist

- [ ] Focused behavior, tests and docs are consistent.
- [ ] No customer data, credentials or raw sensitive stores are included.
- [ ] Quorum/durability, persisted identities and recovery boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Logging, installation/version and compatibility changes are documented.
- [ ] Third-party notices and approved policies are preserved.
- [ ] I reviewed/tested the contribution and can explain it, including AI-assisted work.
